title: Payment Plan Months for Long-Standing Ostomy Supply Program Enrollments
content:
Tenure lengthens an Ostomy Supply Program payment plan. Tenure is measured in whole calendar months from the program's enrolled date to the day the plan is set up.

| Months enrolled | Months added to the number of installments |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 2 (the long-tenure months) |
| At least 36 but fewer than 60 | 1 (the mid-tenure month) |
| Fewer than 36 | None |

These months are added to the number of installments.

**Boundaries (hypothetical).** 35 months enrolled: none. 36 months: 1. 59 months: 1. 60 months: 2.
